notes: Shared 1.5B generator: Bloom transformation + SQuAD QA + arXiv paper summarization.
Summarization source is ccdv/arxiv-summarization using its official train/validation/test splits.
Bloom transformation uses the canonical BloomShift final candidate; source-group separation is checked.
The 0.5B Bloom classification dataset is excluded from generator SFT.
Maximum sequence length is 8192; complete summarization examples over the budget are excluded rather than mismatching a full-document summary to a truncated article.
12 epochs is a maximum; early stopping and best-validation-checkpoint selection remain enabled.
This config uses a new output directory so it cannot accidentally resume or overwrite the previously trained task-weighted adapter.
loss_objective: Per-example mean assistant-token cross entropy, with Bloom rewrite weighted 1.5x; prompts remain masked.
